candidate.answerReason: The first expression multiplies three factors of -3. The second is the additive inverse of 3 cubed. Both values are -27.

methods.label: Interpret each power before evaluating
methods.explanation: \((-3)^3\) means multiplying 3 factors of \((-3)\), giving \((-3)\times(-3)\times(-3)=-27\). The expression \(-3^3\) means the additive inverse of \(3^3\), giving \(-(3\times3\times3)=-27\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 meanings of exponentiation, signed multiplication, and additive inverses.
